# Version transparency

The reproducibility check was completed in December 2024, based on the version of the authors' repository available at that time (i.e., commit [32cfd57](https://github.com/grossmania/Forecasting-Tournament/tree/32cfd57c635d08a54a2eff8f735382c3c16336ac) on branch `main` of <https://github.com/grossmania/Forecasting-Tournament>).

To ensure transparency and long-term verifiability, we created an unsynchronized fork at <https://github.com/anamartinovici/Forecasting-Tournament>. The evaluated repository state (i.e., commit 32cfd57) is available at: <https://github.com/anamartinovici/Forecasting-Tournament/tree/32cfd57c635d08a54a2eff8f735382c3c16336ac>

# Materials availability

Materials related to the reproducibility check (including code, preregistration, and report files) are available at <https://github.com/Meta-Science-Replication-Team/repro-Forecasting_Tournament>. An archival snapshot of version v1.0.0 is preserved on Zenodo (<https://zenodo.org/records/16698261>, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.16698260).
